label: Environment: verify Poetry, Python, Node, npm
args: set -eu; for tool in poetry python3 node npm; do if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'Missing prerequisite: %s\n' "$tool" >&2; exit 1; fi; "$tool" --version; done

label: Backend: Ruff
command: poetry run ruff check app tests

label: Backend: security tests
command: poetry run pytest tests/test_security.py tests/test_support_security.py tests/test_auth_isolation_boundaries.py tests/test_admin_tier_authorization.py tests/test_auth_helpers.py

label: RAG: core tests
command: poetry run pytest tests/test_rag_service_unit.py tests/test_rag_happy_path.py tests/test_rag_endpoints.py

label: RAG: retrieval tests
command: poetry run pytest tests/test_retrieval_selection.py tests/test_lexical_candidate_selection.py tests/test_lexical_candidate_filter_precedence.py tests/test_final_context_selector.py

label: Frontend: quality
command: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run type-check

label: Quality: backend
command: poetry run ruff check app tests && poetry run mypy app/ --strict --pretty && poetry run pylint app/ --rcfile=.pylintrc --fail-under=9.0 && poetry run lizard app/ -l python -C 25 -w

label: Quality: fast
args: set -eu; cd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/backend"; poetry run ruff check app tests; poetry run mypy app/ --strict --pretty; poetry run pylint app/ --rcfile=.pylintrc --fail-under=9.0; poetry run lizard app/ -l python -C 25 -w; cd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/frontend"; npm run lint; npm run format:check; npm run type-check

label: Quality: full
args: set -eu; cd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/backend"; poetry run ruff check app tests; poetry run mypy app/ --strict --pretty; poetry run pylint app/ --rcfile=.pylintrc --fail-under=9.0; poetry run lizard app/ -l python -C 25 -w; poetry run basedpyright app; poetry run pytest; poetry run pytest tests/test_security.py tests/test_support_security.py tests/test_auth_isolation_boundaries.py tests/test_admin_tier_authorization.py tests/test_auth_helpers.py; cd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/frontend"; npm run quality:check; npm run build
